Sandbox_daysPerYear_tooltip: Number of in-game survival days that count as one year of character age. Useful with mods such as Surviving Through Seasons that change the length of a year. This only changes aging in TIHYD, not the game's calendar or day length.
Sandbox_isDeathEnabled_tooltip: Rolls once each in-game day after the minimum age. Daily risk is derived from annual risk using Days per year.
Sandbox_isTraitsConsidered_tooltip: Physical and health traits can lower or raise annual mortality risk before it is converted to daily risk.
Sandbox_deathAge: Minimum age for death by old age
